description: This file defines a Swift enum 'GatewayLaunchAgentManager' with static methods for managing a launch agent daemon on macOS. It handles enabling, disabling, checking status, and configuration snapshot of the launch agent, including interactions with the filesystem, launchd, and shell commands.

classes.name: CommandResult
classes.description: Struct to represent the result of a daemon command execution, including success status, payload data, and message.

classes.name: ParsedDaemonJson
classes.description: Struct representing parsed JSON data from daemon command output, including raw text and JSON object.

methods.name: isLaunchAgentWriteDisabled
methods.description: Checks if the disable launch agent marker file exists to determine if writing is disabled.

methods.name: setLaunchAgentWriteDisabled
methods.description: Enables or disables writing of the launch agent by creating or removing a marker file.

methods.name: isLoaded
methods.description: Asynchronously checks if the daemon is loaded by reading its status.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Enables or disables the launch agent based on parameters, executing appropriate shell commands.

methods.name: kickstart
methods.description: Restarts the daemon via a command.

methods.name: launchdConfigSnapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of the current launchd configuration.

methods.name: launchdGatewayLogPath
methods.description: Determines the log file path for the gateway, preferring snapshot paths if available.

methods.name: readDaemonLoaded
methods.description: Reads and parses daemon status JSON to determine if the daemon is loaded.

methods.name: runDaemonCommand
methods.description: Runs a daemon command and returns nil on success or an error message.

methods.name: runDaemonCommandResult
methods.description: Executes a daemon command and returns a detailed CommandResult object with success status, payload, and message.

methods.name: withJsonFlag
methods.description: Ensures the list of command arguments includes '--json'.

methods.name: parseDaemonJson
methods.description: Parses raw JSON output from daemon commands into a structured object.

methods.name: summarize
methods.description: Summarizes last line of command output text for logging.
